method: Viewed native-pixel contact sheets for all four cases, three evenly spaced interior frames per case.
observations: The two candidates make only small contrast changes to existing SQ3 textures. No clear recovery of the source coral geometry is visible in the reviewed frames.
Video2 fish markings and coral ridges become slightly more pronounced; fish and tail shapes remain visually close to SQ3 at these sampled times.
Video1 and video3 preserve the sampled SQ3 composition; previously missing or distorted subject details are not restored by this operation.
No conspicuous new halo or clipping is visible in these samples. This limited observation is not a claim about every pixel or every frame.
decision: Both fixed strengths failed the frozen numerical constraints. Keep SQ3 as the user-accepted fallback; do not extend these candidates to the long video.
